programme.title: Garage Squad
programme.desc: The crew helps the Calumet City police rebuild a camper they use to deliver food and toys to needy families during the holidays.

programme.title: Truck U

programme.title: Truck U
programme.desc: The 1951 Willys pickup that Matt Steele got from Willie B last year is in the shop for the first time. We will build a new firewall, tear down the engine for some new upgrades, and build out the Dana 44 axles that will end up under the truck.

programme.title: Build for Off-Road
programme.desc: Ian completes wiring on a modified C10 and prepares for a dyno run; he upgrades the transmission, radiator and other components to manage increased power.

programme.title: Build for Off-Road
